blogs.title: Designing REST APIs That Scale in Django
blogs.author: Shihab
blogs.excerpt: A practical guide to designing clean, scalable REST APIs in Django with consistent patterns, pagination, and error handling.
content: Start with consistent resource naming and predictable URL structures. This makes it easier for clients to navigate and for teams to maintain the API over time.
Use pagination, filtering, and ordering as first-class features. Pair this with clear error responses and versioning to keep your API stable while it evolves.

blogs.title: Caching with Redis: Patterns for Django Apps
blogs.author: Shihab
blogs.excerpt: Use Redis for page, object, and fragment caching to speed up Django apps without sacrificing correctness.
content: Choose the right caching layer for each use case: full-page for public content, fragment for complex templates, and object caching for expensive queries.
Always pair caching with safe invalidation strategies. Use cache keys with versioning to avoid serving stale data after deploys.

blogs.title: HTMX for Server-Driven Interfaces
blogs.author: Shihab
blogs.excerpt: Build fast, interactive interfaces with minimal JavaScript by using HTMX and server-rendered HTML.
content: HTMX keeps complexity low by letting the server return HTML fragments for dynamic updates. This reduces client-side state management.
Combine HTMX with Django templates and partials to create responsive, maintainable UI flows.

blogs.title: Vue.js Architecture for Admin Dashboards
blogs.author: Shihab
blogs.excerpt: A structure-first approach to building maintainable admin dashboards with Vue.js components.
content: Create a solid foundation with reusable layout components and a clear folder structure. Keep data fetching separate from UI concerns.
Define consistent design tokens and component patterns to keep the dashboard cohesive as it grows.

blogs.title: Deploying Django with Nginx and Gunicorn
blogs.author: Shihab
blogs.excerpt: A reliable deployment checklist for Django apps on Ubuntu with Nginx, Gunicorn, and systemd.
content: Start with environment isolation using virtualenv, secure settings, and a production-ready configuration for static and media files.
Use systemd services for Gunicorn and configure Nginx as a reverse proxy for performance and security.

blogs.title: Secure Authentication Flows for Web Apps
blogs.author: Shihab
blogs.excerpt: Build secure authentication with strong password policies, session protection, and user-friendly recovery flows.
content: Enforce strong passwords, use secure hashing, and limit login attempts. Pair with MFA when possible for sensitive applications.
Implement session rotation and secure cookie settings. Always provide clear, safe account recovery experiences.
